text.description_html:
Acorn RL7BP, 3-7/16 Inch Arrowhead Latch

The 3-7/16 Inch Arrowhead Latch is for cabinet doors and light weight doors on furniture or closets. The 3-7/16 Rough Black Iron Arrowhead Cabinet Latch comes packaged as a complete set with latch, screws, and plates. it is great for adding a historic look to your colonial home or a rustic feel to your farmhouse inspired decor.

Also Available 2-13/16" Arrowhead Latch

Specifications for the Acorn Arrowhead Cabinet Latch:

  • Finish: Rough Black Iron
  • Length: 3-7/16"
  • Width: 2-5/32"
  • Set Includes: latch, latch plate, strike plate, and mounting screws.

Sold Individually
